# Duration field (`duration-field`)

Free-text duration entry ("1h 30m").

Group: Text inputs. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/text-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createDurationField` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/durationField.d.ts`): `.mh-duration`: free-text duration entry inside a `.mh-field`. The box shows how the text reads as you type (`__preview`); on Enter or leaving the field the text is read (see `parseDuration`), checked against `min` and `max` and rewritten in short form (`1h 30m`), or the field shows why it can't be. Optional `__presets` buttons under the box set common lengths in one press (`aria-pressed` on the current one).

```ts
export function createDurationField(options: DurationFieldOptions): DurationFieldHandle;

export interface DurationFieldOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  /** Seconds; `null` for empty. */
  value?: number | null;
  placeholder?: string;
  /** The unit of a bare number (default minutes). */
  defaultUnit?: DurationUnit;
  /** Shortest and longest accepted, in seconds. */
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  /** Durations offered as buttons under the field (seconds), e.g. timer lengths. */
  presets?: readonly number[];
  presetsLabel?: string;
  /** A leading icon; default a timer, `false` for none. */
  icon?: string | false;
  name?: string;
  helper?: string;
  error?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  size?: InputSize;
  labelStyle?: 'label' | 'eyebrow';
  messages?: Partial<DurationMessages>;
  /** Called with the seconds once the text is committed (Enter, leaving the field, or a preset), `null` when emptied. */
  onChange?: (seconds: number | null) => void;
}

export interface DurationFieldHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  field: FieldHandle | null;
  getValue(): number | null;
  setValue(seconds: number | null): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}

export interface FieldHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  label: HTMLLabelElement | HTMLSpanElement;
  /** The described element (input, select, textarea or the control). */
  target: HTMLElement;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setSuccess(text: string | undefined): void;
  /** Updates the counter: `3 / 40` with a max, `3` without. */
  setCount(count: number, max?: number): void;
  /** Dims the label and messages (the control disables itself). */
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`formatDuration` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/durationField.d.ts`): A duration as text: `short` is `1h 30m` (also what the field reads back), `long` is `1 hour 30 minutes`.

```ts
export function formatDuration(seconds: number, style: 'short' | 'long' = 'short'): string;
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createDurationField, formatDuration } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = document.createElement('p');
const timer = createDurationField({
  label: 'Timer',
  value: 1500,
  presets: [300, 600, 900, 1800, 3600],
  max: 4 * 3600,
  helper: 'Try 90, 1h 30 or 0:45. A number alone is minutes.',
  onChange: (seconds) => (status.textContent = seconds === null ? 'No timer.' : `Timer: ${formatDuration(seconds, 'long')}`),
});

document.body.append(timer.el, status);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { DurationField } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import { formatDuration } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function DurationFieldExample() {
  const [seconds, setSeconds] = useState<number | null>(1500);
  return (
    <DurationField
      label="Timer"
      value={seconds}
      presets={[300, 600, 900, 1800, 3600]}
      max={4 * 3600}
      helper={seconds === null ? 'Try 90, 1h 30 or 0:45.' : `Rings in ${formatDuration(seconds, 'long')}.`}
      onChange={setSeconds}
    />
  );
}
```
